## Metadata
- Task ID: TASK-035-A
- Owner: A / Shared Infrastructure / QA
- WBS: 9.1
- Status: Ready
- Depends on: 2.9 + 2.10 completed
- Planned branch: `codex/a-test-baseline-freeze`

## Objective
审计仓库现有 Node tests、browser harness、DB runtime tests、routing/security/observability 专项与 CI 执行方式，建立统一可复跑测试基线与分层入口；优先复用现有框架，不重复安装第二套测试体系。

## Scope
- test inventory / ownership / coverage gaps
- unit / contract / integration / DB / browser / live-provider classification
- canonical npm scripts / CI mapping
- deterministic fixtures and test data rules
- flaky / environment-dependent / Deferred taxonomy
- baseline counts tied to commit but not hard-coded as永久通过
- minimal missing smoke only where needed
- docs, Result, WBS, Issue, Draft PR

## Boundaries
不为了追求数字大量新增无价值测试；不改业务逻辑以迁就测试；不把 live provider / Safari / cloud DB 未执行项写 PASS；不自动 merge。

Task / Codex command 将发布到 `docs/tasks/`。

The PR is not merged and WBS 9.1 is not marked complete. Live providers, external Auth/SMS, Safari/mobile devices, and cloud deployment remain explicitly Deferred.

## TASK-035-A / WBS 9.1 — B Phase 1 audit publication receipt (2026-10-06 JST)

Static CI selection is 152 direct Node files plus 1 indirect Node and 3 indirect Python files = 156 unique test files; 27 test files have no proven CI selection. The six primary lanes are 5 / 37 / 37 / 36 / 36 / 1, with disjoint union equal to the 152-file selector. Suites/cases executed remain null.

Unresolved dimensions are explicit: 487 candidates need at least one ownership/layer/prerequisite review, 200 owners are not uniquely supported, and 15 text references need contextual review (including embedded/generated source and deliberate absence assertions). No unknown was silently made false. All nine old PR changed files were reviewed: 6 REWORK, 2 DEFER, 1 historical REUSE_AS_IS; the typecheck subchange is SUPERSEDED by current develop.

Validation separation:

- **auditValidation: PASS** — two complete fixed-Git scans produce byte-identical JSON; unique IDs/paths, counts, resolved references and shard union verified; 10 in-memory generator self-checks. [Receipt](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/blob/dbf8875250bb22ec8f9d647c84bf7e438aee12d7/docs/qa/TASK-035/phase-1/audit-validation.json).
- **businessTestsExecution: NOT_EXECUTED** — no repository Node/Python regression, graph rebuild/extraction/resume/proof, browser/device, DB/Auth, real Provider, lint/typecheck/build/deploy execution. No target runner/import, dependency installation, POI production or db:reset.
- **ciStatus: no run observed for this audit publication**; no manual dispatch. Earlier develop push [run 37422119153](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/actions/runs/37422119153) was observed as success through the API only; its actual checkout/proof receipt was not independently verified here and is not Phase 1 execution. PR merge-ref evidence must not be called branch exact-head evidence.

**Protected-file changes: 0.** The commit changes only 13 allowed QA/Task/Result/WBS documents. WBS validation confirms only its 9.1 section/row changed. [Scope receipt](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/blob/dbf8875250bb22ec8f9d647c84bf7e438aee12d7/docs/qa/TASK-035/phase-1/scope-validation.json). CI/package/lockfiles, existing runners/tests, business code, migrations and POI/Transport/Asset data were untouched.

Post-push observation: #265 remains OPEN; #272 remains OPEN / Draft / unmerged at the same head; no audit PR exists. This external receipt confirms the amendment checklist's final two publication/stop items, intentionally left unchecked in the pre-publication commit to avoid a self-referential SHA cycle. **Execution has stopped for human review; Phase 2 has not started.**

## TASK-035-A / WBS 9.1 — B Phase 2 Task 已发布（2026-10-06 JST）

用户在 Phase 1 交付审查后要求第二阶段 Task。沿用 #265 / #272；Canonical Owner 仍为 **A / Shared Infrastructure / QA**，**B 执行支持**。

- [第二阶段完整 Task（固定提交）](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/blob/997ce9ed5e5da621398d56bf8bfa89531a5084dd/docs/tasks/AMENDMENT-TASK-035-b-wbs-9-1-phase2-baseline-integration.md)
- 发布分支：`docs/b-wbs-9-1-phase2-task-20261006`
- 发布提交：`997ce9ed5e5da621398d56bf8bfa89531a5084dd`
- 继承 Phase 1：`dbf8875250bb22ec8f9d647c84bf7e438aee12d7`
- 唯一实现分支：`codex/a-test-baseline-freeze`；复用原 Draft PR #272，不另建替代实现。

本阶段范围：校准实际执行集合；最小统一 Node/分片入口与机器回执；修复 verify 上传条件、expectedHead 适用面与 Python 前置；实际 clean-develop/candidate 验证。保留原强制测试、TASK-086 全部证明链与失败传播，区分 PR merge-ref 和 branch exact-head。

不要求 487 个外围待核候选全部清零，不再整体重做审计；无 Docker/浏览器/Provider 凭据不自动成为未修改 opt-in 层的完成阻塞。未执行项目仍明确 NOT_EXECUTED。禁止业务/数据/迁移/版本升级、生产 Provider 调用、默认分支写入、自动合并及关闭 Issue。

本次**仅发布任务文档**，未执行第二阶段实现或测试，未修改原实现分支/CI/业务/WBS 状态。执行开始后按 Task 同步 WBS；强制验证全部通过后仅标“待审查”，停在人工审查点。Refs #265 #272。

TASK-035-A / WBS 9.1 Phase 2 外部交付回执（B 执行；Canonical Owner A）

最终提交：`a77ec0ae24a555aba09ed6c6fc6520d2a5e2442c`，已正常推送原分支 `codex/a-test-baseline-freeze`。状态：**阻塞，强制验证未通过**；不是待审查或完成。原 PR #272 保持 Draft；Refs #265，Issue 保持 Open。

| PR_MERGE_RESULT | [37467203410 / 1](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/actions/runs/37467203410) | `f15d9bfa8062605c6f13829ef70f2981d955da2b` | 同三项必跑失败；不是分支 head 实测 |

PR head 为上述最终提交，base 为 `4888b4d507ee75d4f6b9914eb1a8d5661813f64b`。两次运行的日志、事件与回执哈希、run/attempt、输入/清单哈希及选择集合已下载核验；每次五个分片实际153个直接文件，rebuild另1个未完成，不能把3,898写成全仓全部通过。Linux Node v24.21.0、Python 3.12.14；最终已完成的 Asset、regression-0/2、retained extraction、quality（lint/types/scoped format/local build/artifact/diff）通过。

阻塞根因：TASK086 `currentBinding()` 对 `package.json` 和 `.github/workflows/quality-gate.yml` 做全字节绑定；本次获准的统一入口/CI接线使已冻结认证输入失效。三个失败来自 certification-engine-repair（2）和 readmittable-closeout（1）。只读、纯内存哈希对照证明只有这两项绑定变化即可重现差异；没有替换测试期间的文件、修改预期值、跳过断言或刷新受保护证据。需 A / 认证证据 Owner 在对应范围另行裁定刷新证据或绑定规则，当前 Task 不授权该修复。

两条最终运行在强制失败确认后取消剩余昂贵图作业，整体结论为 cancelled/blocked；graph未完成、resume/rebuild/proof、完整 `npm test` 和完整 aggregate **NOT_RUN / NOT_COMPLETED**，不声称完整链成功。候选72fe79f29的旧运行仅作历史，未挪用为最终head通过。

已核验 clean develop 基线 [37422119153](https://github.com/kanzakimy0/TravelAssist/actions/runs/37422119153)：精确4888b4d、516项输入绑定、152文件、3,887 tests及原完整证明链通过。旧工作流未记录实际Python版本，故不声称完全相同环境的差分。Windows原30秒Asset超时在独立clean develop与候选均复现（164/165），原断言/超时保持；Linux两侧Asset通过。

治理测试12/12、基础设施兼容23/23、scope/只读清单校验通过。默认动态清单154直接+4间接；不增加DB/browser/Provider默认义务，不要求清零外围487候选。Local DB、浏览器/真机、bundle/replay、TASK055/059 local aggregate、live Provider/OAuth/SMS/cloud未运行。无db:reset、无数据生产、无依赖/lock/Node版本变更；其他工作树未提交内容保留。
